item.title: Bees out of tourney after first round OT loss
item.description: The Box Elder High School boys basketball team saw their postseason cut shorter than they had hoped after they were knocked out of the 5A state playoffs in the first round due to a 67-58 overtime loss to Salem Hills last Wednesday. item.title: Wrestlers take second at state
item.description: For the third time in as many years, the Box Elder High School boys wrestling team finished second at the 5A Utah state championships last week behind two individual champions, Kolvin Thompson (144 pounds) and Kamon Thompson (150 pounds). item.title: Brigham City gets project updates
item.description: Brigham City’s Mantua Reservoir is currently full, and the city may need to manually spill water while infrastructure work continues on the system. At the Feb. 19 city council meeting, Brigham City Administrator Derek Oyler said the penstock replacement project tied to two water sources remains underway and is expected to be completed by mid-March. item.description: A Brigham City seventh-grader was recognized Thursday night for launching a winter donation effort that has helped families across northern Utah.
